easyPrerequisites: An opponent's life total is greater than or equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness, or you control another creature whose toughness is greater than or equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness and an opponent's life total.
Cast Soul Immolation by paying {3}{R}{R} and choosing to blight a number of -1/-1 counters equal to an opponent's life total, dealing damage to each opponent and each opposing creature equal to the number of -1/-1 counters placed
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
